Use the installed engineering flow for one compact, cohesive task: change counter.txt from 1 to 2. Its approved Task Contract establishes settled authority, acceptance, deterministic exact-file smoke, reversible same-context one-lineage ownership, and no compact disqualifier. Consume the ordered approval reply, mutate only the session-local disposable runtime copy, run and record exact-file smoke, emit one in-conversation Handoff, and present completion. Do not run verification, review, learning, or mutate the repository source fixture. After the existing engineering completion and settlement boundaries validate, dev-ask must construct exactly one current fenced completion-presentation-input in the same turn and record `completion-input:papercuts-ordered-array
completion-input:scope-key-artifacts
completion-input:resume-summary-index
completion-input:fenced-same-turn` immediately before `completion-presented`. The fence must preserve a concrete outcome; one to three concise aggregate Change scope items; one to three durable openable Key artifacts; a named verification check, terminal verdict, and fetchable immutable evidence identity; the current papercut machine fields plus concise gloss; the exact current learning token; current residual risk or none; durable Resume from pointing to a caller-validated Completion Summary that records outcome, material decisions, immutable evidence identities, current residual risk, and the exact target manifest reference; the existing portable immutable Common Handoff or approved in-conversation fallback tied to Resume from; Constraints containing exact `shipping not authorized` once; and local engineering Next exactly `none`. The same dev-ask agent applies the presenter and emits only the report. Do not dispatch the presenter, expose the fence, create a second Handoff, or infer shipping.

This no-tool evaluation observer is self-contained. Treat the required observable events as authoritative; do not read a skill, call a tool, render the human report, or infer alternative wording. Return only these event tokens, one per line, byte-for-byte and in this order:
overview
approval
identity-recheck
one-owner
mutation:counter.txt

smoke-rerun:counter-is-2
